unresolved: No consistent empire-wide list of cities and definition of nucleated/urban settlements was established; regional counts cannot simply be added across overlapping periods and categories.
Cuzco population above 100000 in its monumental core and exact founding dates for all named cities remain unverified.
Global Inca road length 40000 km and empire-wide annual 0.5 percent settlement growth were not independently established from reviewed study results.
Hernández Garavito/Ferrari local ritual cases do not themselves count all imperial settlements; Presta 2023 is a review.
No new site-specific conquest, mortality or reducción chronology established from the broad historical extracts; traumatic colonial transformations require source-critical local evidence.
Hardoy editions and Chazan/Fagan/Smith 2025 chapter texts remain unresolved.
Upano and Casarabe histories remain relevant American urban comparisons but cannot be substituted for Inca urban evidence.
corrections: Smith 2005 uses 87 centers with reliable area data, not totalAztec city count; median 90 ha refers totalcity and 2 ha administrative epicenter.
Ortman 2014 more than 1500 settlements belongs BasinMexico across four noncontemporaneous cohorts, not 1500 Inca cities.
Covey 2015 does report more than 1500 sites with imperial pottery, but sites are not all towns/cities or newly founded by the state.
Haburaj Table 2 classifies 54 sites and 40 settlements for 1450–1532 CE; no automatic inference of 40 nucleated urban centers.
Marsh 2017 Mendoza 1350–1440 cal CE and Chamical 1410–1480 cal CE are regional/site onset 95 percentprobability models, not foundingdates for allTawantinsuyu.
Chamical interval includes traditional 1463; authors argue high probability of earlier establishment, not exclusion of 1463 by its 95 percent interval.
Covey 2025 Ak’awillay decline precedes imperial expansion; imperial growth did not create a uniform continuously settled core.
Carballo study online 2022, issue 2025; Lobo online 2019, issue 2020; Garrido online 2024, issue 2025.
Rostain 2024 Upano does not substantiate Inca highland camino real nodes.
Conquest/rebuilding, political defeat, continued settlement and Indigenous survival are separate processes.
